data.name: GrunglePunch
data.detailed_description:
In an alternate reality of South America where animal fighting has become the norm, "Grungles" have been created to fulfil humanity's animalistic desire for BATTLE.

Multiplayer:

GrunglePunch contains a high-octane and boisterous multiplayer PvP mode. With up to 4 player games, players engage in free-for-all combat against one another or AI players. With a broad range of Arm Modules and Items, engage in a violent power fantasy against your friends. Knocking them out of the game's many unique maps.

Customization:

Individuals can customize their grungles with a large set of colors and hats, turning them into their very own unique little monsters. Further customization options can be unlocked as players progress through the story, discover hidden secrets, and unlock challenging achievements.

Story:

The story of GrunglePunch episodically follows the tales of many different grungles and their HEARTBREAKING experiences in this awful world. Guide them through vast complexes, difficult battles, and puzzles too confusing for their tiny, pathetic brains. Learn about the many applications of grungles and their relationship with the people who use them.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: 4+ Core Processor
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated Graphics or higher
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: This game can run on some pretty potato-ey systems.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: 6+ Core Processor
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated Graphics
  • Storage: 1 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Once again, you don't need much :^)
